finding.title: Initial PluginView context can retain empty viewId
finding.evidence: New ConversationMessageSettings initializes viewId to empty. MessageSettingsComposer renders PluginView with binding.context() before useLayoutEffect configures it, and wrapper does not subscribe to binding. PluginView retains its context prop; its own host subscription cannot recompute the parent prop. validateContext rejects empty composer viewId.
finding.impact: Initial settings extension show can fail and remain failed until an unrelated parent render supplies a new context; later self-refresh is not proof first mount works. This is source inference, not an observed browser failure.
finding.action: Build the PluginView composer context from the current render viewId prop, or an equivalent deterministic same-render source inside this owned adapter. Keep shared PluginView unchanged.
finding.validation: The existing real App browser acceptance should cover opening settings from first mount without a prior unrelated render or an Extension context alert.
